scenarios.title: Edit every task detail and persist the result
given: An existing active task is visible
when: The user opens its labelled edit action
The user changes its title, notes, category, priority, and due date
The user saves and reloads the page
then: The updated details are displayed after save and reload
The task identity and completion state are preserved

scenarios.title: Reject an empty edited title
given: An existing task is in edit mode
when: The user replaces its title with whitespace and attempts to save
then: A clear validation message is shown
The original task remains unchanged and the editor stays open

scenarios.title: Cancel editing without changing the task
given: An existing task is in edit mode
when: The user changes its title and chooses Cancel
then: The unsaved title is not stored

scenarios.title: Existing task actions continue to work
given: The task list is visible after using the editor
when: The user adds a task, toggles completion, searches, and deletes a task
then: Each existing action still updates the list as expected
No browser console errors occur during any required scenario
